$comment: Manifest for the RideIQ diagram set. Start here. Each entry is a standalone file you can paste straight into an image model.

meta.intended_tool: Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro (image) or Mermaid (deterministic labels)

how_to_use: Open one file. Paste its image_prompt as your prompt.
Paste the spec object underneath with: 'Here is the exact structure - follow every node label and arrow label precisely.'
Ask for the aspect_ratio named in meta.
Generate 3 or 4 and pick the cleanest. Image models drift on dense text.
For anything that must be EXACTLY right (the blue-green swap, the ML map), also produce a Mermaid version - deterministic labels - and use the generated image only as the hero picture.

files.use: the hero picture - whole system at a glance
inside the EC2 box: containers, networks, volumes, RAM budget
the self-driving pipeline, including the reconciler
open data to live engine, as a conveyor
POST /route-latlon - A* plus the ML chain
GET /transit - the OTP proxy and its 503 fallback
the GPS navigation loop and re-route trigger
the zero-downtime swap and its health gate
A* - f = g + h, and why the heuristic matters
THE conceptual diagram - why transit needs RAPTOR
all 16 ML algorithms mapped to 8 features
timetable plus live feeds, and the honesty rule

also_present.algorithms/: pre-existing per-feature ML JSONs (eta, fare, cancellation-risk, fraud-check, surge-zones, rider-segments, driver-shift, cancellation-causes, routing, _quote-orchestration). Still valid; 13-algo-ml-map.json is the index over them.
SUPERSEDED by 01-system-architecture.json - they predate the transit engine and the current CI/CD.

suggested_reading_order: 07 - how a transit request actually flows
03 - how any of it reaches production
accuracy_note: Every number in this set was read from the running system or the source, not estimated: 96 MB graph, 291k vertices, 6,573 stops, 37 s build, ~61% trip-update coverage, CAD 3.00 Arc fare. One correction is flagged in 13-algo-ml-map.json - the code says '15 ML algorithms' but PIPELINE lists 16 distinct names.
